overview_description: Read and change instance settings: currencies, taxes, warehouses, payment terms, field settings, general settings and more.
intro: Settings hold the configuration of an Exsited instance: currencies, taxes, time zones, warehouses, item groups, variations, discount, shipping and payment set up, custom objects, field settings and the general settings groups. You can read every area and create, change or delete most of its records. This area has 86 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
warning: **Updating the `general` group of general settings sets eight other instance settings, such as `accountingPeriod` and `fiscalYear`, to null, and no API call can set them back.**
notes: **Records travel under a wrapper key.** A currency is under `currency`, a warehouse under `warehouse`, general settings under `general_settings`, and writes use the same key.

**General settings are read and written one group at a time.** `group` is one of `account`, `item`, `date_and_time`, `order`, `purchase`, `labour`, `transaction`, `security`, `dashboard`, `portal`, `display` or `general`; the `item` and `order` groups also carry `product`.
**Some flags are stored as `"1"` and `"0"`.** The dashboard and security groups store flags that way, and a `"true"` sent to the security group is stored as false.
**Currencies and taxes cannot be deleted.** There is no delete call for either, so a currency or tax you create stays on the instance.

**Some writes return a different shape from the read.** A payment term create returns a flat `period` and `duration`, and a payment processor write returns `gateway_name` and `credentials` where a read has `provider`.
**Listings page by cursor.** Pass `limit` for the page size, then pass `pagination.next_cursor` back as `cursor` while `pagination.has_more` is true.

endpoints.title: List custom object schemas
endpoints.summary: Returns a page of custom object schemas under `data`, with paging details under `pagination`.
endpoints.description: Lists the custom object schemas on the instance. Each schema says where it is used (`use_in`) and its `relation`. Pass `limit` to set the page size, and while `pagination.has_more` is true pass `pagination.next_cursor` back as `cursor` to read the next page. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, and `sort` orders the results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the next one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: A page of custom object schemas, under `data`.

parameters.description: The general settings group: one of `account`, `item`, `date_and_time`, `order`, `purchase`, `labour`, `transaction`, `security`, `dashboard`, `portal`, `display` or `general`, in any letter case.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a general setting
endpoints.summary: Returns one general setting row by its `gs_` `id` within a group.
endpoints.description: Reads one general setting row by its `gs_` `id`. No response carries a `gs_` id, so there is no known way to obtain one. An `id` the group does not hold returns `404`, and an unknown group returns `400`.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: The general settings group: one of `account`, `item`, `date_and_time`, `order`, `purchase`, `labour`, `transaction`, `security`, `dashboard`, `portal`, `display` or `general`, in any letter case.

parameters.name: general_setting_id
parameters.description: A general setting's `gs_` `id`. No response carries one.

400.description: The group is not one of the general settings groups.

404.description: The group holds no general setting with that `id`.

endpoints.title: Update dashboard general settings
endpoints.summary: Changes settings in the `dashboard` group of general settings and returns the group under `general_settings`.
endpoints.description: Send the settings to change under `general_settings.dashboard`. Flags are stored as `"1"` or `"0"` and read back as stored, so a `"true"` cannot be written back.

200.description: The `dashboard` group as a read returns it, under `general_settings`.

endpoints.title: Update date and time general settings
endpoints.summary: Changes settings in the `date_and_time` group of general settings and returns the group under `general_settings`.
endpoints.description: Send the settings to change under `general_settings.date_and_time`. The group holds `date_format`, `time_format`, `time_zone` and `first_day_of_week`. Saving this group also sends the organisation to the catalogue processor, an external call.

200.description: The `date_and_time` group as a read returns it, under `general_settings`.

endpoints.title: Update display general settings
endpoints.summary: Changes settings in the `display` group of general settings and returns the group under `general_settings`.
endpoints.description: Send the settings to change under `general_settings.display`. Send column lists as arrays: lists sent as the strings a read returns are ignored, and an array write resets their order.

200.description: The `display` group as a read returns it, under `general_settings`.

endpoints.title: Update the general group of general settings
endpoints.summary: Changes settings in the `general` group. It also resets eight other instance settings that no call can set back.
endpoints.description: Send the settings to change under `general_settings.general`. Saving this group also sets `accountingPeriod`, `fiscalYear`, `autoSaveBudget`, `customComponentActivity`, `enableRequireAction`, `strictBankAccountMatching`, `enableGrandOdata` and `addressRestrictedMode` to null, and no API call writes them back. Do not send this call unless you can reset those settings in the Exsited web app.

200.description: The `general` group as a read returns it, under `general_settings`.

endpoints.title: Update labour general settings
endpoints.summary: Changes settings in the `labour` group of general settings and returns the group under `general_settings`.
endpoints.description: Send the settings to change under `general_settings.labour`. Values are strings such as `"true"` and `"false"`.

200.description: The `labour` group as a read returns it, under `general_settings`.

endpoints.title: Update order general settings
endpoints.summary: Changes settings in the `order` group of general settings and returns the group under `general_settings`.
endpoints.description: Send the settings to change under `general_settings.order`. The save reads both `general_settings.order` and `general_settings.product`.

200.description: The `order` group as a read returns it, under `general_settings`.

endpoints.title: Update portal general settings
endpoints.summary: Changes settings in the `portal` group of general settings and returns the group under `general_settings`.
endpoints.description: Send the settings to change under `general_settings.portal`. While `enableCustomerPortal` is off, any write to this group also turns every portal login off.

200.description: The `portal` group as a read returns it, under `general_settings`.

endpoints.title: Update purchase general settings
endpoints.summary: Changes settings in the `purchase` group of general settings and returns the group under `general_settings`.
endpoints.description: Send the settings to change under `general_settings.purchase`. Values are strings such as `"true"` and `"false"`.

200.description: The `purchase` group as a read returns it, under `general_settings`.

endpoints.title: Update security general settings
endpoints.summary: Changes settings in the `security` group of general settings and returns the group under `general_settings`.
endpoints.description: Send the settings to change under `general_settings.security`. Send flags as `"1"` or `"0"`: the `"true"` a read returns is stored as false.

200.description: The `security` group as a read returns it, under `general_settings`.

endpoints.title: Update transaction general settings
endpoints.summary: Changes settings in the `transaction` group of general settings and returns the group under `general_settings`.
endpoints.description: Send the settings to change under `general_settings.transaction`. Saving this group rebuilds every invoice default.

200.description: The `transaction` group as a read returns it, under `general_settings`.

endpoints.title: Create a payment processor
endpoints.summary: Creates an offline payment processor and returns it under `payment_processor`.
endpoints.description: Send the new processor under `payment_processor`, with a `gateway_name` such as `CASH`, the `currency` `id`, and `credentials.maximumRetryOnFailure` set to `"0"` or `"1"`; without that value the create is refused. The response carries `gateway_name` and `credentials` where a read has `provider`.

gateway_name.description: The gateway, such as `CASH` for an offline processor.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a payment processor
endpoints.summary: Returns one payment processor by its `id`, under `payment_processor`.
endpoints.description: Reads the payment processor with this `id`. The `id` is the one a listing or a create returns.

parameters.name: payment_processor_id
parameters.description: The payment processor's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

endpoints.title: Update a payment processor
endpoints.summary: Changes the fields you send on a payment processor and returns it under `payment_processor`.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change under `payment_processor`. Like a create, the update is refused unless it carries `credentials.maximumRetryOnFailure` as `"0"` or `"1"`.

parameters.name: payment_processor_id
parameters.description: The payment processor's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

endpoints.title: Delete a payment processor
endpoints.summary: Deletes a payment processor. The response has no body.
endpoints.description: Deletes the payment processor with this `id`. Reading the same `id` afterwards returns `404`. The default processor cannot be deleted.

parameters.name: payment_processor_id
parameters.description: The payment processor's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

204.description: The payment processor is deleted. The response has no body.

endpoints.title: Create a payment term
endpoints.summary: Creates a payment term and returns it under `payment_term`.
endpoints.description: Send the new term under `payment_term`, with a `name`, a `period` such as `DAILY` and a `duration`. The response has a flat `period` and `duration` where a read nests them under `duration`. A `status` you send is not applied.

duration.description: How many periods until payment is due.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a payment term
endpoints.summary: Returns one payment term by its `id`, under `payment_term`.
endpoints.description: Reads the payment term with this `id`. The `id` is the one a listing or a create returns. A read nests the period and count under `duration`.

parameters.name: payment_term_id
parameters.description: The payment term's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

endpoints.title: Update a payment term
endpoints.summary: Changes the fields you send on a payment term and returns it under `payment_term`.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change under `payment_term`, such as `description`. The response has the read's fields and `display_order`.

parameters.name: payment_term_id
parameters.description: The payment term's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

endpoints.title: Delete a payment term
endpoints.summary: Deletes a payment term. The response has no body.
endpoints.description: Deletes the payment term with this `id`. Reading the same `id` afterwards returns `404`.

parameters.name: payment_term_id
parameters.description: The payment term's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

204.description: The payment term is deleted. The response has no body.

endpoints.title: Create a pricing level
endpoints.summary: Creates a pricing level and returns it under `pricing_level`.
endpoints.description: Send the new level under `pricing_level`. `name` is required, and a `status` you send is not applied. The response has `price_tax_inclusive` where a read has `is_tax_inclusive`, `tax_inclusive_based_on` and `tax_code`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a pricing level
endpoints.summary: Returns one pricing level by its `id`, under `pricing_level`.
endpoints.description: Reads the pricing level with this `id`. The `id` is the one a listing or a create returns.

parameters.name: pricing_level_id
parameters.description: The pricing level's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

endpoints.title: Update a pricing level
endpoints.summary: Changes the fields you send on a pricing level and returns it under `pricing_level`.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change under `pricing_level`, such as `description`.

parameters.name: pricing_level_id
parameters.description: The pricing level's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

endpoints.title: Delete a pricing level
endpoints.summary: Deletes a pricing level. The response has no body.
endpoints.description: Deletes the pricing level with this `id`. Reading the same `id` afterwards returns `404`. The default level cannot be deleted.

parameters.name: pricing_level_id
parameters.description: The pricing level's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

204.description: The pricing level is deleted. The response has no body.

endpoints.title: Create a shipping profile
endpoints.summary: Creates a shipping profile and returns it under `shipping_profile`.
endpoints.description: Send the new profile under `shipping_profile`. `name` and `shipping_type` are required, and a `FIXED` profile also needs `fixed_amount`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a shipping profile
endpoints.summary: Returns one shipping profile by its `id`, under `shipping_profile`.
endpoints.description: Reads the shipping profile with this `id`. The `id` is the one a listing or a create returns.

parameters.name: shipping_profile_id
parameters.description: The shipping profile's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

endpoints.title: Update a shipping profile
endpoints.summary: Changes the fields you send on a shipping profile. Every body tested returns `500`.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change under `shipping_profile`, such as `description`. Every body tested returns `500`, so this call has no known working body.

parameters.name: shipping_profile_id
parameters.description: The shipping profile's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

endpoints.title: Delete a shipping profile
endpoints.summary: Deletes a shipping profile. The response has no body.
endpoints.description: Deletes the shipping profile with this `id`. Reading the same `id` afterwards returns `404`.

parameters.name: shipping_profile_id
parameters.description: The shipping profile's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

204.description: The shipping profile is deleted. The response has no body.

endpoints.title: Create a warehouse
endpoints.summary: Creates a warehouse and returns it under `warehouse`.
endpoints.description: Send the new warehouse under `warehouse`. `name` and `country`, the country's `country_` `id`, are required. The response's `country` reads null even though the country is stored; read the warehouse to see it.

is_default.description: Whether this is the default warehouse.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a warehouse
endpoints.summary: Returns one warehouse by its `id`, under `warehouse`.
endpoints.description: Reads the warehouse with this `id`. The `id` is the one a listing or a create returns.

parameters.name: warehouse_id
parameters.description: The warehouse's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

endpoints.title: Update a warehouse
endpoints.summary: Changes the fields you send on a warehouse and returns it under `warehouse`.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change under `warehouse`, such as `description`. The response's `country` reads null although the record has one.

parameters.name: warehouse_id
parameters.description: The warehouse's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

warehouse.description: Main warehouse for New South Wales
Main warehouse for New South Wales

endpoints.title: Delete a warehouse
endpoints.summary: Deletes a warehouse. The response has no body.
endpoints.description: Deletes the warehouse with this `id`. Reading the same `id` afterwards returns `404`.

parameters.name: warehouse_id
parameters.description: The warehouse's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

204.description: The warehouse is deleted. The response has no body.

endpoints.title: Create a tax
endpoints.summary: Creates a country tax and returns it under `tax`.
endpoints.description: Send the new tax under `tax`. `code` and `country` are required. There is no call that deletes a tax, so a created tax stays.

country.description: The country the tax applies in.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a tax
endpoints.summary: Returns one tax by its `id`, under `tax`.
endpoints.description: Reads the tax with this `id`, the record the listing returns. The record includes its `country` and any rates by state under `country_tax_by_states`.

parameters.name: tax_id
parameters.description: The tax's `id`, as the listing returns it.

endpoints.title: Update a tax
endpoints.summary: Changes a tax, or enables or disables it.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change under `tax`, or its `status` to enable or disable it.

parameters.name: tax_id
parameters.description: The tax's `id`, as the listing returns it.

endpoints.title: Delete a variation
endpoints.summary: Deletes a variation. The response has no body.
endpoints.description: Deletes the variation with this `id`. Reading the same `id` afterwards returns `404`.

parameters.name: variation_id
parameters.description: The variation's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

204.description: The variation is deleted. The response has no body.
